plan.required: COMMON-bank verdicts (legacy AUDIT_FIT pipeline + fresh ATTACK_FIT_NEW pipeline), NULL_CALIBRATION on the common bank, ROT; per-pipeline verdicts diagnostic
plan.common_rule: union over the banks in bank order [legacy D0, legacy D1 | legacy D1, fresh]: winner = first bank whose half-A-selected AUC beats the running best by more than 1e-12; evaluated on half B

fit_roles.legacy: AUDIT_FIT (lra.audit._split_audit on lra.audit.policy_views of each original release)
fit_roles.fresh: ATTACK_FIT_NEW (hcal.bank.fresh_views; S* restricted to these rows)
fit_roles.rot: AUDIT_FIT (lra.audit.controls_for_release unchanged: the admitted U reader pipeline)

plan.rule: fixed by structure before any control runs: the task-only code, the JOINT code at the largest registered lambda, the class-only code and the constrained code with the largest registered neighbourhood, each with every original release and every registered lookup table

limits.null: every view: held-out AUC_B <= 0.5 + 3.5 sd0 (sd0 = Mann-Whitney null sd on half B)
limits.XOR: AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and AUC_B(v1) <= null threshold and AUC_B(v2) <= null threshold
limits.ROT_r1_ROT_r2: AUC_B(v_i) > 0.75 and AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and serialisation exact
limits.null_calibration: 5 permutations (seed CONTROL_SEED + 100 + rep); pass iff no exceedance of 0.5 + 3.5 sd0
limits.realised_threshold_rule: the realised null threshold must equal the source's within 1e-12 (fixed split and permutation seeds on the same roles); otherwise a technical failure
limits.plants_in_candidate_bank: never (in-memory / temporary-directory releases, never saved as units)

views.codes: the fresh complete view of each control partition with its FULL registered table set (hcal.bank.fresh_views); fit ATTACK_FIT_NEW with permuted SEX, select on INNER half A, evaluate on half B
views.rot: SRC|U interface through lra.audit.controls_for_release unchanged (fit AUDIT_FIT)

units: one control audit per (job, check); planted releases in memory / temporary directories only, never saved as units, never in a candidate bank
timing: after SCIENCE_LOCK; must pass before nomination / EVALUATION_LOCK; a failure is a technical validity issue, never a negative method outcome; synthetic tests never replace these
